rows.producer: SetLocationData(actor whoCares) ignores parameter, fixes playerRef; GetCurrentLocation; GetParentCell.GetName; GetWorldSpace.GetName
rows.consumer: BuildLocationContext prefers currentLocation, falls back cell then historical location context
rows.refresh: Maintenance and player OnLocationChange; not every SetContext
rows.missing_stale_semantics: Missing Location tries parent-cell first 20 refs then object under feet; still absent writes empty. Cell/worldspace None writes empty; no timestamp/quality bit
rows.observation_vs_inference: Direct player fields; alternate reference location is proxy inference; not per-NPC location

rows.missing_stale_semantics: No parent deliberately retains old hold; no clear; no verified ancestor traversal/hold keyword
rows.observation_vs_inference: Field label hold does not establish actual hold; parent-location direct read plus semantic assumption

rows.consumer: BuildLocationContext renders indoor protection; collected trespass not shown by inspected builder
rows.missing_stale_semantics: Boolean strings; no observation time; trespass changes within same Location may remain stale
rows.observation_vs_inference: Interior/trespass direct flags; indoors out of weather is presentation inference

rows.producer: SetLocationData checks currentLoc.HasKeywordString LocType* and joins tokens with ~
rows.consumer: BuildLocationContext maps keyword tokens to descriptions
rows.missing_stale_semantics: Empty when unavailable; no unsupported vs unknown distinction
rows.observation_vs_inference: Record keyword classification; not visual or navigational discovery

rows.producer: GetDayState derives half-hour bins from Utility.GetCurrentGameTime; bIsNight threshold; StoreMoonData emits flag
rows.refresh: Player AIFF high frequency default5 real timer seconds after work; dayState write only if nonempty
rows.missing_stale_semantics: No timestamp; dayState empty skips write and may retain prior value
rows.observation_vs_inference: Calendar-derived label; not sunrise event/actual illumination observation

rows.consumer: BuildWeatherContext calls GetWeatherContext; indoors may prefix Outside
rows.refresh: Player default5 real timer seconds plus work
rows.missing_stale_semantics: Raw Weather None not explicitly guarded here; no age/confidence; collected classification alone does not prove every custom-weather description
rows.observation_vs_inference: Engine classification direct; PHP text/special-weather mapping is presentation

rows.producer: GetCurrentMoonPhase game-days %24 with noon adjustment; GetCurrentMoonSync days%5
rows.consumer: BuildMoonPhaseContext reads target actor, phase switch and day/night wording
rows.missing_stale_semantics: PHP empty(moonPhase) suppresses valid string0; target may lack player-only fields; missing returns empty
rows.observation_vs_inference: Calendar arithmetic predicts phase/count; no sky visibility/cloud/occlusion observation

rows.producer: Papyrus GetNearbyAIStr uses external AIFF.findAllNearbyAgents. PHP DataBeingsInRange2 independently reads latest infonpc eventlog
rows.consumer: BuildNearbyCharactersContext merges eventlog people + party + speaker/player/target then batchfetches actor kv
rows.refresh: Papyrus player refresh; PHP latest infonpc query, request Globals cache; native scan cadence/range not established
rows.missing_stale_semantics: No infonpc age cutoff; absent rows empty; names case-insensitive dedup; collection can include non-near party/target; same-name collisions possible

rows.scope: actor name keyed; PLAYER global namespace
rows.producer: SetActorVariable -> AILogMessage setconf -> external AIAgentFunctions.logMessage; PHP conf_opts lookup
rows.refresh: Fieldwise sends; env+combat each refresh; survival/followers medium15 game seconds; other modules low30 game seconds; voice once per name
rows.missing_stale_semantics: No actor kv TTL/observed_at. Missing string empty, missing bool false. Globals cache no age or global snapshot transaction. Name mutex/version not stable actor ID

rows.fields: modName; eventKey; eventValue; npcName; ttl; expiresAt
rows.producer: MinAI_SetContext/NPC -> StoreContext @ wire -> custom_context upsert key(modname,eventkey), expiresAt=time()+ttl
rows.consumer: GetCharacterSpecificThirdPartyContext/GetGlobalThirdPartyContext require expiresAt>now. Mantella fallback AddInGameEvent loses persistence
rows.refresh: On ModEvent; server wall-clock TTL; TTL0 immediately expires in this fork pin
rows.missing_stale_semantics: Expired omitted; same mod/key across NPCs overwrites because key excludes npcName; no structured provenance; malformed @ escaping not established
rows.observation_vs_inference: Third-party supplied text/narrative assertion, not necessarily observed engine fact

rows.fields: id; section; priority; enabled; header; builder_callback; is_nsfw; role=system/content
rows.producer: ContextBuilderRegistry registered PHP callbacks consume actor store
rows.consumer: BuildSystemPrompt -> UpdateSystemPrompt replaces head[0]; context.php216 hook
rows.refresh: Per prompt construction; priority order; enable/section/category filtering
rows.missing_stale_semantics: Empty callback output omitted; noncallable skipped; Exception logged. No token budget/distance topN found in inspected builder path; not proof about downstream CHIM trimming
